data.metaTitle: The Celts come alive again at Havránok, 13 July 2013
data.metaDescription: An event at the open-air museum on the Celtic hillfort of Havránok — a journey 2,000 years back in time among Celts, Germanic peoples and Romans.

children.text: On 13 July 2013, in the open-air museum at the

, every pilgrim who comes here will find himself more than 2,000 years back in time, in the days when the ancient peoples of the Celts, the Germanic peoples and the Romans, and occasionally nomadic hordes from the east, were moving about the territory of present-day Slovakia. You have the chance to meet them all in person at the splendid event called Živý starovek (Living Antiquity). You will see how they lived, how they dressed, what they ate, how they fought and what cults they practised.

The event is held every year; it is organised by the Vae Victis group and its quality keeps improving. Groups from abroad have also confirmed their participation, and you can believe us that we really do have something to look forward to.
So, all of you with an interest in antiquity, we shall meet at Havránok.
